description: Bellamydwarsstraat 4-10 (BAG 1933 after renewal; a late-19th-century front): dark brown brick, three equal axes of white T-windows under flat brick heads, no balconies, a thin cornice band; a dormer with a hoist beam over the centre

match.note: renewal years (1933) stand in BAG for many 1890s fronts here, so the year range is wide; on 1904 rows the balcony-axis type competes and the photo (challenger NCC) decides

hoist-dormer.note: a white-framed dormer over the centre axis with the hoist beam's hooks (Bellamydwarsstraat 10, 8)

rhythm.groundFloor: house door in an outer axis
rhythm.roofline: thin cornice band, a dormer with a hoist beam

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 2-5: identical 3-axis fronts, white dormers with hoist hooks

schemaLimits: the light brick lintel course over the second-storey windows
